test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an invisible biological hazard in food?
solution:
The correct answer is **Molds**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Molds** are a type of fungi that can grow on food and are invisible to the naked eye until they form colonies.
 
• They produce spores that can contaminate food and potentially cause health issues if ingested.
 
• Molds can produce mycotoxins, which are toxic substances that can lead to foodborne illnesses.
 
• Unlike visible biological hazards like worms or weevils, molds are often not detected until they have significantly grown.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Molds
 Molds are microscopic fungi that can grow on food, producing spores and mycotoxins, which can cause health issues.
 
 

 Worms
 Worms are visible parasites that can contaminate food but are not invisible hazards.
 
 

 Weevils
 Weevils are small beetles that infest grains and seeds, but they are visible to the naked eye.
 
 

 Fly
 Flies are insects that can contaminate food through physical contact, but they are visible.
